plan.title: Submit RFQ Bid and Verify Buyer Response

steps.note: the API built this case's state
Enable the required eRFX project capability before accessing the live RFQ.
Switch to Vendor A's separate supplier-portal session.
Open the live RFQ's pricing round in the vendor portal.
Enter 100 in the bid sheet, which submits the complete vendor quote after the required terms are handled by the portal flow.
Assert that the vendor portal shows the bid as submitted.
Verify the vendor view identifies the submitted quote as the current bid.
Check for the post-submission revise/edit control; the exact product label may differ.
Return to the buyer's event page.
Open the RFQ Responses tab to verify the buyer-side response.
Assert Vendor A's direct response, the 1/2 participation count, and the buyer's response column.
Open Master QCS to verify the submitted bid appears in the comparison grid.
Assert that Master QCS has a real Vendor A column.
Verify the buyer sees Vendor A's unit bid of 100.
Verify the buyer-side line total and overall total are calculated from the submitted rate and quantity.
